title: read of a missing file
notes: 'prog.pdl:1', the line of the `read:` block. It was 'prog.pdl:0' until phase-3 item 0: a top-level block has an empty location path and `get_line` returned 0 for it, so the one block a single-block program has was the one thing that could not be located. Clean message otherwise; location stays 1 because no column or block path is printed.
